preventive_protocol_metadata.note: Protocols are individualized by the attending veterinarian based on lifestyle risk assessment.

non_core_lifestyle_vaccines.lifestyle_criteria: Boarding, grooming, dog daycare, or dog park exposure
Exposure to standing puddle water, wildlife corridors, or rural trails
Boarding, daycare, shows, or regional outbreak
Tick-endemic regions, hiking, or wooded yards

parasite_prevention.heartworm_screening: Annual canine antigen SNAP test required prior to refilling preventative
parasite_prevention.preventative_schedule: Monthly year-round oral/topical isoxazoline and macrocyclic lactone
parasite_prevention.intestinal_parasites: Fecal flotation test at least once yearly (twice in puppies and in high-risk dogs); dewormed at 2, 4, 6, and 8 weeks as puppies
parasite_prevention.dose_basis: Weight-based; recalculated at every wellness visit

wellness_exam_cadence.seniors_over_7_years: Every 6 months, with annual bloodwork and urinalysis

non_core_lifestyle_vaccines.lifestyle_criteria: All kittens under 1 year; adult cats with outdoor access or exposure to unknown cats

parasite_prevention.heartworm_screening: Heartworm antigen/antibody screening on a risk basis; monthly preventative recommended year-round
parasite_prevention.preventative_schedule: Monthly year-round topical or oral flea, tick, and heartworm preventive labeled for cats
parasite_prevention.intestinal_parasites: Fecal flotation test at least once yearly; dewormed at 2, 4, 6, and 8 weeks as kittens
parasite_prevention.flea_and_tick: Monthly year-round; cat-specific products only. Dog permethrin products are toxic to cats
parasite_prevention.dose_basis: Weight-based; recalculated at every wellness visit

wellness_exam_cadence.seniors_over_10_years: Every 6 months, with annual bloodwork, urinalysis, and blood pressure

lifestyle_risk_factors.rationale: Bats, wild vectors, and virus carried on shoes and clothing can enter the home.
Airborne respiratory pathogens spread quickly in shared spaces.
Wildlife, standing water, and ticks raise exposure.
